model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The provided image displays a line chart illustrating the changes in sparsity ratios across three different conditions: “sparsity ratio before gate,” “sparsity ratio after gate,” and “sparsity ratio after average gate.” The chart visually compares the trends of these ratios over a sequence of data points, with each condition represented by a distinct line style and color.

The x-axis represents a sequence of discrete data points, labeled numerically from 1 to 20, with each point corresponding to a specific measurement or iteration. The axis lacks a labeled unit or descriptive title, and the scale is linear and evenly spaced.

The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, with values ranging from approximately 0.0 to 0.6. The axis is labeled with numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.1 (0.0, 0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.6). The unit of measurement is not explicitly stated in the axis label.

Three lines are plotted:

- The orange dotted line, labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.55,” begins at a value of approximately 0.55 at x=1 and exhibits a general downward trend, ending near 0.4 at x=20. It shows some fluctuations, including a slight upward movement between x=10 and x=12, and a more pronounced upward spike between x=16 and x=18.

- The green dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33,” starts at approximately 0.55 at x=1 and decreases steadily to approximately 0.3 at x=20. It has a relatively smooth decline with minor fluctuations, remaining consistently below the orange line throughout the entire range.

- The blue dashed line, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44,” begins at approximately 0.44 at x=1 and remains nearly flat, with minor fluctuations, ending at approximately 0.35 at x=20. It is positioned between the other two lines, showing a slight downward trend over time.

The chart visually demonstrates the comparative behavior of these three sparsity ratios across the sequence of data points, with the “before gate” ratio starting highest and decreasing more sharply than the others, while the “after average gate” ratio shows the most consistent decline.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该线图展示了三种不同条件下稀疏率（sparsity ratio）随某个未标注的x轴变量变化的趋势。图中包含三条线：一条橙色虚线代表“门控前稀疏率，平均值0.63”；一条绿色虚线代表“门控后稀疏率，平均值0.44”；一条蓝色虚线代表“平均门控后稀疏率，平均值0.33”。x轴未标注具体标签、刻度类型、数值范围或单位，其数值刻度间隔未明确显示。y轴未标注具体标签、刻度类型、数值范围或单位，其数值刻度间隔未明确显示。橙色虚线从左上角开始，数值较高（约0.63），随后整体呈下降趋势，但在后半段出现小幅波动并略有回升。绿色虚线从左上角开始，数值略低于橙色虚线，随后整体呈下降趋势，后半段也出现小幅波动。蓝色虚线在整个x轴范围内保持在较低水平，数值稳定在约0.33附近，几乎无明显变化。
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratios at three different stages—before a gate, after a gate, and after an average gate—across a range of values on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.33” and spans from approximately 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44,” ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are plotted: a yellow dotted line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, which starts near 0.6 and decreases to around 0.2; an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after the gate, which starts near 0.6, dips to around 0.3, and then fluctuates upward to approximately 0.5; and a green dashed line for the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which begins near 0.6, declines to about 0.2, and then slightly rises to around 0.3 before leveling off. A blue dashed line, which appears to represent a different metric, remains consistently low, hovering near 0.1 across the entire x-axis range.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Verlauf des Sparsity-Ratios für drei verschiedene Zustände – vor einem Gate, nach einem Gate und nach einem Durchschnittsgate – entlang einer nicht numerisch beschrifteten x-Achse, die vermutlich eine sequenzielle oder diskrete Abfolge von Experimenten, Modellen oder Zeitpunkten repräsentiert. Die y-Achse ist numerisch skaliert, vermutlich linear, mit Werten zwischen 0 und 1, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen nicht explizit angegeben sind, aber die durchschnittlichen Werte der Linien (0.65, 0.44, 0.33) auf den Wertebereich hinweisen. Die obere, gestrichelte orangefarbene Linie, die den „sparsity ratio before gate“ darstellt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0.65 und fällt zunächst stark ab, bevor sie sich in einem Bereich zwischen etwa 0.35 und 0.45 stabilisiert. Die mittlere, gestrichelte grüne Linie, die den „sparsity ratio after average gate“ darstellt, beginnt ebenfalls bei etwa 0.65, fällt ebenfalls stark ab und stabilisiert sich schließlich bei etwa 0.33. Die untere, durchgezogene blaue Linie, die den „sparsity ratio after gate“ darstellt, bleibt über den gesamten Verlauf nahezu konstant bei einem Wert von etwa 0.44, mit leichten Schwankungen um diesen Wert.
